sentences.en: The result of the examination fell short of our expectations.
sentences.zh: 考试的结果没有达到我们的预期。

sentences.en: I was all the more disappointed because of my expectations.
sentences.zh: 正因为有期待，我更加失望。

sentences.en: His new book did not come up to our expectations.
sentences.zh: 他的新书没能满足我们的期望。
